note: Retention periods are a legal decision (PIPA, Korean tax/e-commerce record keeping, immigration-related obligations, university contracts). Every period_days below is null until Hangyul's counsel and the owner set it; the engine skips a policy whose period is null. Do not fill these in from defaults or examples.

policies.description: Accounts with a DELETE data request: grace period after deletion_requested_at before the account is anonymised and its documents deleted from storage.
Older (non-current) file versions of a vault document: object deleted from storage, version row removed.
Attachments uploaded but never posted with a message.
Expired email/SMS one-time-code challenges (target address, delivery status).
Expired or revoked refresh-token hashes (IP, user agent).
Product analytics events: the user link is removed, aggregates are kept.
Access and change audit trail. Deliberately long-lived; counsel decides.
Operational failure records (no personal content by construction).
